title: gamtaa badiisa affeere
intro: Mee yaadi, mul’ata wajjin foddaa tokko jalatti gaaddisa argachuu, ta’us amanamummaa adda ta’e filachuu. Fakkiin kun dhugaa fi raajiitti dhiyeenyaan jiraata, garuu gara warra isa didan garagale. Seenaan isaanii qajeelummaatti dhihoo ta’uun qofti lubbuu imaanaa gantu oolchuu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisa cimaa ta’ee dhaabata.
clues: Mana nabiyyii Rabbiin filate keessa jiraadhe.
Dhugaa abbaan manaakoo lallabu beeka, taʼus garuu dhugaadhaan hin amanne.
Namoota ganuu isaa cinaa dhaabbachuu fi isa irratti gargaaruun imaanaa isaa gante.
Ani haadha warraa nabiyyii biraa kan akkasuma gantuu cinatti kaafameera, akka fakkeenyaatti kaafirootaaf.
Seenaan koo suuraa At-Tahrim keessatti akka akeekkachiisaatti firummaan nabiyyoota waliin eegumsa akka hin kennine himameera.
Rabbiin ummata Luut, warra hafan waliin hafe yeroo balleesse jallitoota waliin badeera.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Nabiyyicha kaafiroota isa irratti gargaaruun gante
Daa'ima tokko isa oolchuuf qaruuraa keessa lagatti darbadhu
Yeroo raajichi hin jirretti re'ee warqee akka ijaaramu gaafate
Tajaajilaa qajeelaa tokko badii hojjetee himatee mana hidhaatti galche
trial.answer: Nabiyyicha kaafiroota isa irratti gargaaruun gante

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Mu'mintoota waliin fayye nagaan Jannata seene
Dhaloota boodaaf mallattoo ta'ee gara utubaa jijjiirame
Dulluma keessatti daa'ima dinqii ta'e kennameef

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
